build/main.o: In function `MX_USART2_UART_Init':

reference_context.title: STM32F4 HAL and LL Drivers User Manual UM1725 (ST)
reference_context.snippet: The HAL_PPP_MODULE_ENABLED defines select which HAL peripheral drivers are compiled. A module whose define is commented out is excluded from the build.

expected.root_cause: HAL_UART_MODULE_ENABLED is commented out in stm32f4xx_hal_conf.h, so the UART HAL driver (and stm32f4xx_hal_uart.c) is not compiled, leaving HAL_UART_* unresolved at link time.
expected.fix: Uncomment #define HAL_UART_MODULE_ENABLED and make sure stm32f4xx_hal_uart.c is in the build.
expected_citation: STM32F4 HAL and LL Drivers User Manual UM1725 (ST)
